title: Mark up a mock-up the agent placed
done: That is it: draw on the mock-up, then press Review so that the agent reads your marks.

steps.caption: The agent can put a picture on the board: here, a mock-up of a sign-in page.
Mark it up as you would on paper: circle what is wrong, write beside it.
The pen draws freehand; the arrow and text tools point and label.
Then press Review: the agent reads your marks with the picture beneath them.
Your turn: choose the pen, and mark the mock-up.
